decisions.reason: Finned tubes for air coolers are a core component that is cheap to keep, closely tied to the firm's established air cooler business, and had their own page through 2019 while sister launches were dropped, so the option still looks worth holding.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes extend the firm's core tube know-how at low carrying cost and survived the 2019 portfolio cleanup, so with the missing 2020–2021 evidence not signalling failure, keeping the option open is the better choice.
